vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: Acronym of الدولة الإسلامية في العراق والشام (ad-dawla al-ʔislāmiyya fī l-ʕirāq wa-š-šām, literally “The Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant”). It resembles the Arabic words دَاعِس (dāʕis, “that tramples”) or دَاحِس (dāḥis, “one who causes discord”).

Etymology tree
Arabic دَاعِش (dāʕiš)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic داعشي
From دَاعِش (dāʕiš, “ISIL”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
